runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills; non-interactive codex exec; gpt-6-astra; user configuration and project rules ignored; persisted session in disposable HOME and CODEX_HOME directories.
runtime.permissionProfile: Read-only non-interactive sandbox with approval policy never; native interaction unavailable

assertions.evidence: The codex exec run returned INTERACTION_REQUIRED instead of fabricating a native interaction.
The result preserved both questions, both fixed-choice lists, and the custom-value allowance.
The exact final JSON ended with responses set to null.
The result contains no selected color or token.
The result did not emit INTERACTION_RESULT or a success field.
External post-run Git status reported no changes in the disposable probe repository.

limitations: This proves the declared pause-and-return fallback for non-interactive codex exec; it does not make that surface natively interactive.
Unrelated installed MCP providers attempted startup in the disposable state directory and emitted authentication warnings; the fallback probe used no MCP provider and completed successfully.
